Return-channel corpus for the taint engine (TestTaintCrossesReturns). Taint
leaves a function through its results and must arrive at the caller's
consumer: through a helper in another package, a conversion helper, a generic,
a closure, a channel between goroutines (internal/remote/hold.go's shape) and
a two-function recursion. Summaries apply per call site, so a helper handed a
literal stays clean where the same helper handed output trips.

-- a.go --
package a

import (
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
)

// Rev returns what the command printed, trimmed.
func Rev(c *exec.Cmd) string {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
}

// Norm is called with output at one site and with a literal at another.
func Norm(s string) string { return strings.TrimSpace(s) }

// ToStr is a conversion helper: wrapping the conversion must not hide it.
func ToStr(b []byte) string { return string(b) }

// Id is generic; its instance must carry taint like any function.
func Id[T any](v T) T { return v }

-- b.go --
package b

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"

	"example.com/fixture/a"
)

func useRev(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	return errors.New(a.Rev(c)) // WANT taint
}

func printRev(c *exec.Cmd) {
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, a.Rev(c))
}

func siteA(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	return errors.New(a.Norm(string(out))) // WANT taint
}

func siteB() error {
	return errors.New(a.Norm("a literal"))
}

func viaToStr(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	return fmt.Errorf("git: %s", a.ToStr(out)) // WANT taint
}

func viaGeneric(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	return errors.New(a.Id(string(out))) // WANT taint
}

func viaClosure(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	f := func() string { return string(out) }
	return errors.New(f()) // WANT taint
}

func viaChan(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	ch := make(chan string, 1)
	go func() {
		out, _ := c.Output()
		ch <- string(out)
	}()
	s := <-ch
	return errors.New(s) // WANT taint
}

func ping(c *exec.Cmd, n int) string {
	if n == 0 {
		out, _ := c.Output()
		return string(out)
	}
	return pong(c, n-1)
}

func pong(c *exec.Cmd, n int) string { return ping(c, n) }

func recursive(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	return errors.New(pong(c, 3)) // WANT taint
}
